answer: Locks are written down in vertex, expire in meadow, and falcon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 33 aliases therefore needs 146 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 178 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
